R7486-R7500.summary: A letter of the numbered series from the Vienna agent signing 'Sidon' to Baron Schenck, chamberlain of Augustus II, at Cracow, 7 March 1706: court news and intrigue in clear German, with the two-digit letter cipher deciphered (in braces) and most three-digit person codes left open.

snip.cap: The head of N. 18, 7 March 1706: clear German with runs of the letter table and code numbers
snip.credit: Archiwum Narodowe w Krakowie, AKM 21 plik 30/1, letter N. 18 p. 1, via DECODE R7486

system: German clear text with a 2-digit homophonic letter table in alphabetical blocks of three (a=7-9, b=10-12 ... no j, v), 3-digit codes for persons, courts and words (the 500s an alphabetical word list), and dotted letter signs that are a code for small words…
